h:
只是一个简单的 TXT 到 IMG 工作流程，其中包括升级和提示生成 LLM。

我是这个场景的新手，刚刚学习。想分享我过去几天一直在研究的工作流程。我也有详细信息作为一个选项，但决定不将其包含在这里，因为我仍在学习这一点。

我一直在 PONY 上使用它，但我了解到，只要模型全部匹配（如检查点、lora、vae 等），那么你使用这些节点做什么并不重要，这是我早期的一个解脱原因，我认为我必须为 PONY 建立一个特定的构建，一个为 SD 构建，一个为......

o.en:
Just a simple TXT to IMG Workflow that includes Upscaling and Prompt Generation LLM.

I'm new to the scene and just learning. Wanted to share a workflow I've been working on over the last few days. I have Detailing as an option as well but decided not to include it here as I"m still learning about that.

I've been using it with PONY but what I've learned is that as long as the models all match (Like checkpoint, lora, vae, etc) then it doesn't matter what you use these nodes for, which is a relief cause early on I thought I had to have a specific build for PONY and one for SD and one for....
